title: Link elevation callbacks and StratumTracker use inverted locks
description: Python StratumTracker status/current/adopt paths hold the tracker RLock and then call DioTimeVerifier._with_live_generation(), which waits for LinkLayer._security_lock. Public LinkLayer elevation methods invoke synchronous user callbacks while holding _security_lock; such a callback may call tracker.status/current_time and wait for the tracker lock. Concurrent execution creates tracker->link versus link->tracker ABBA deadlock. Redesign lock ordering/transaction boundaries without losing generation linearizability and add deterministic cross-thread regression tests for authenticated-DIO, verified-receipt, and time-generation callbacks.
notes: Final rereview found remaining lease-level ABBA despite releasing _security_lock before callbacks: thread A holds StratumTracker.__lock and waits for a foreign signer generation lease; thread B owns that lease and its public elevation callback waits for the tracker lock, so neither can release. Fix callback/lease/tracker ordering and add deterministic two-thread regression for time-generation and authenticated-DIO elevation.
